sections.lead: 17+ years shaping confident, curious learners in reputed Dhaka schools — through student-centred teaching, one-to-one counselling and Cambridge-standard classroom practice.

columns.title: Teaching
columns.body: Leading a class at **Glenrich International School, Satarkul** — planning engaging, student-centred lessons aligned with curriculum objectives and keeping the room organised, positive and inclusive.

columns.title: Counselling
columns.body: Supporting students' **academic, social and emotional development** through counselling, individual guidance and close collaboration with colleagues and parents.

columns.title: Assessment
columns.body: Monitoring progress with **constructive feedback**, and invigilating **Cambridge O Level & A Level** examinations to Cambridge regulations and standards.

columns.title: Growth
columns.body: Still learning — **Microsoft Elevate Educator Expert**, Cambridge professional development, and an ongoing **Adolescent Counselling** course.

sections.label: Classroom // Teaching_Standards // 2026

items.title: Student-Centred Learning
items.practice: Lessons are planned around how each learner thinks — not only what the syllabus says — guided by Cambridge learner attributes.
items.outcome: Confident, reflective learners who take ownership of their own progress.

items.title: Pastoral Care
items.practice: Every concern is heard. Counselling and one-to-one guidance sit alongside the timetable, never after it.
items.outcome: A classroom where every child feels seen, safe and supported to grow.

items.title: Academic Integrity
items.practice: Assessment follows the standard — from daily feedback to Cambridge O & A Level examination procedures.
items.outcome: Results that are fair, earned and trusted by parents and schools alike.

sections.closing: These commitments shape every lesson, every conversation and every examination hall I step into — with professionalism, care and integrity.
